payload.detail: UPDATE 2026-10-27: the pilot cannot run as written; it is parked. Read-only checks on main a68d875c2 and the owner's own SQL read found three blockers: (1) worker/admin-text-inspection.ts admits only text/plain sources or one hard-coded four-page national PDF (exact byte length and hash) and refuses catalogue entries whose jurisdiction is not Australia, so WA PDFs are refused whatever scanner is used; (2) no malware-scanner module exists (WORKER_ADMIN_SOURCE_RUNTIME_MODULE was removed on 26 Oct; deferral in docs/decisions/2026-10-27-defer-worker-malware-scanner.md); (3) existing documents carry no admission event or authority metadata, and the library file names no longer match the CG.MHSP names above. Nothing was changed or spent. Next step if wanted: a separately approved security change widening the inspection gate to general PDFs and WA sources, then the pilot. PRIOR DETAIL: UPDATE 2026-10-23: OWNER DECISION - a three-document re-index pilot is approved (CG.MHSP.ClozapinePresAdminMonitor.pdf, CG.MHSP.Lithium.pdf, MHSP.AgitationArousalPharmaMgt.pdf), hard cap US$5, baseline Eval Canary 39759615452 and one after run; the worker is limited with WORKER_ALLOWED_DOCUMENT_IDS and paused again afterwards. The full library re-index stays stopped until the owner decides again on the pilot result (docs/decisions/2026-10-23-reindex-pilot-approved.md). The PRs the stop waited on (#3715, #3716, #3732 via #3750) merged and have been live since 22 Oct 2026. PRIOR DETAIL: UPDATE 2026-10-20: OWNER DECISION - the library re-index is STOPPED. Do not start it and do not re-raise it; the owner treats the question as settled. This supersedes the 2026-09-25 conditional approval below (see docs/decisions/2026-10-17-library-reindex-stopped.md). Source: the owner's decision as relayed in the 17 Oct 2026 project handover, which lists the library re-index (stopped) among settled decisions; the owner's exact wording is to be confirmed in the pull request that records it. Any future re-index would need a new owner decision, a spend cap and the live canary pair. PRIOR DETAIL: UPDATE 2026-09-26 (Railway connector read): the precondition is met. The production worker is running commit f7c9beeaa (deployment 0ac40fc7, SUCCESS 05:30 UTC) and then 2459df42 from 05:44 UTC; both descend from db7432a9b, the PR #2810 extraction fix, and from 103513f2d (PR #3040, unreadable-PDF refusal). Re-index and the canary pair can now start, but need a session with Supabase and OpenAI credentials; this one had neither. PRIOR DETAIL: OWNER DECISION 2026-09-25: re-index and the canary pair are APPROVED, conditional on first confirming the worker running in production includes the PR #2810 extraction fix. Not started: this session had no Supabase/OpenAI/Railway credentials and the Railway MCP was unreachable, so neither the deploy check nor the re-index could be run. PRIOR DETAIL: REVIEW 2026-09-25 (offline audit of current main; no provider access): Canonical re-index row. Absorbs closed #4WR2XZ (cause fixed by PR #2810, db7432a9b) and action 1 of closed #SCYQAE. 'Production still serving a708a95, pre-fix' is stale: db7432a9b is an ancestor of the 2026-09-22 app deploy 76bf29ffa, and later merges touching worker/** and src/lib/** (#2865, #2835, #3002) should have rebuilt the worker. Not verifiable offline, so step 1 (confirm the worker runs the fix) stays. PRIOR DETAIL: SEQUENCING GUARD, written because the obvious next action is wrong if taken today. The extraction fix merged to main as db7432a9b on 2026-09-16. Production was still serving a708a95093c7922163166b7bafc63afd6852bc69 immediately afterwards, which PREDATES the fix (verified via /api/health deploymentCommitSha, uptime 2754 s). RE-INDEXING BEFORE THE INGESTION WORKER CARRIES THE FIX RE-EXTRACTS WITH THE OLD CODE. That achieves nothing, spends provider budget on embeddings, churns the live clinical corpus and produces a false all-clear, because the re-indexed chunks would still carry interleaved table text. ORDER OF OPERATIONS: (1) confirm the worker service, not just the app service, is running a build that contains db7432a9b; the two are separate Railway services in project Database and both auto-deploy from main, so confirm the worker specifically. (2) Run Step 6 of scripts/operator-clozapine-retrieval-diagnosis.sql to get the per-document re-index worklist; it is read-only and its fingerprints were validated against real production text. (3) Capture an eval canary BASELINE before re-indexing. (4) Re-index the worklist documents. (5) Capture the canary POST run. Per AGENTS.md RAG ranking protection the before/after pair belongs around the RE-INDEX, not around the merge, because the merge cannot change any retrieval result until documents are re-ingested; PR #2810 said so explicitly and must not be treated as canary-cleared. (6) Only then expect the four clozapine eval cases to move, and note they may still not pass if the underlying RKPG document is itself wrong, which is its own P1 row. Re-indexing is provider-backed and mutates the live clinical corpus, so it needs explicit owner approval at the time, not standing approval from this session.
